READ THE LIST

Three metrics. Equal weight.

01

Median

The middle recorded performance. Half the sampled clears fall above it and half below.

02

Q3

The 75th percentile. One quarter of sampled clears exceed this value, showing stronger typical performance.

03

Ceiling

lostark.bible’s upper whisker, capped by the observed maximum. This is the source’s Ceiling statistic; “Best” is a separate value.

04

Combined score

Rank each build within each gate and metric. Average those rank positions: lower is better. Both gates, all three metrics and all four raids have equal weight.

Source settings & scope

Fully re-pulled on 2 November 2026. Kazeros Hard G1/G2, Serca Hard G1/G2, Horizon Cathedral Level 2 G1/G2, Belgardin Hard G1/G2. September 2026 balance dataset, nDPS, Combat Power 1000 ≤ CP < 15000, bus and weird logs excluded. This is a current balance-period snapshot, not November-only clears. Support builds are excluded; damage engravings on support classes are included.

Combat Power selects the population; these absolute nDPS statistics are not divided by Combat Power. Different gear distributions and player populations can still affect the results. The stagger section includes DPS and support builds and uses each gate’s default Stagger statistic from lostark.bible (Stagger or Stagger per minute); only within-gate rank positions are combined, never raw values across different measures. Displayed values retain the source’s 0.1M precision. Equal displayed values share a competition rank; therefore near-tied source values may be grouped.

Tier boundaries & small samples

Tiers use average rank position across the selected comparisons: S ≤ 8, A ≤ 18, B ≤ 30, C ≤ 42, D > 42 (out of 56 builds). These are editorial display bands, not statistical significance boundaries. Missing gate data is never treated as zero DPS; a build must have all selected gates to receive a combined placement. Fewer than 100 logs in any selected gate is marked Limited. Logs are observations, not unique players. Classes with small samples can move sharply.
